item.title: SLB doubles Shreveport footprint to support global digital infrastructure, data center growth
item.description: SHREVEPORT, LA – SLB announced it will invest $30 million to expand its operations in Caddo Parish, building on its transformation of the former GM assembly plant into a modern, climate-controlled advanced manufacturing hub. The project underscores the company’s role in the hyperscaler supply chain and its long-term commitment to Louisiana’s advanced manufacturing sector.
